hex.config.title: Hex Config
hex.color.title: Colour picker
hex.color.chroma.tooltip: Flow through the rainbow instead of holding one colour. Speed is on this feature's own tab.
hex.color.none.tooltip: No colour of its own — leave whatever colour it already had.
hex.color.copy.tooltip: Put this colour on the clipboard.
hex.color.paste.tooltip: Read a colour from the clipboard. #RRGGBB, RRGGBB and 0xRRGGBB all work.
hex.color.paste.invalid: The clipboard does not hold a colour
hex.config.profiles_button.tooltip: Manage your saved setups: switch between them, rename them, and share them.
hex.config.reset_tab.tooltip: Restore every setting on this tab to its default.
hex.config.reset_tab.title: Reset this tab?
hex.config.reset_tab.message: Restore every %s setting to its default?
hex.config.reset_tab.detail: Your saved profile is untouched, so Discard on the Profiles screen brings these settings back.
hex.config.options_shortcut.tooltip: Open Hex Config, this mod's settings menu.
hex.config.hand.enabled.tooltip: Master switch for the position, scale, rotation and swing settings below. When off, those are kept but ignored. Per-item swing rules have their own switch and keep working.
hex.config.hand.offset_x.tooltip: Moves the main hand right (positive) or left (negative).
hex.config.hand.offset_y.tooltip: Moves the main hand up (positive) or down (negative).
hex.config.hand.offset_z.tooltip: Moves the main hand away from (positive) or towards (negative) the camera.
hex.config.hand.scale.tooltip: Size of the main-hand arm and item.
hex.config.hand.rotation_x.tooltip: Tilts the main hand up and down.
hex.config.hand.rotation_y.tooltip: Turns the main hand left and right.
hex.config.hand.rotation_z.tooltip: Rolls the main hand around its own axis.
hex.config.hand.disable_swing.tooltip: Hides the first-person swing entirely. Attacking, mining and item use are unaffected — only the animation is hidden.
hex.config.hand.swing_items_enabled.tool: Master switch for the per-item list below. Independent of the Enabled switch at the top of this tab, so the list keeps working with the rest of the hand settings off.
hex.config.hand.swing_items.tooltip: Choose Skyblock items whose swing animation is always hidden while you hold them, whatever the switch above says.
hex.config.hand.swing_speed.tooltip: How fast the swing animation plays. This is cosmetic: your attack cooldown and mining speed are unchanged. Has no effect while the swing animation is disabled, and also applies to your own third-person model.
hex.config.freecam.enabled.tooltip: Master switch for the freecam feature and its keybind.
hex.config.freecam.fly_speed.tooltip: Base camera fly speed. Scroll the mouse wheel while flying to fine-tune it.
hex.config.sensitivity.enabled.tooltip: Master switch for the sensitivity hold and its keybind. With it off, the scroll wheel always belongs to the hotbar.
hex.config.sensitivity.step.tooltip: How much one notch of the wheel changes the sensitivity, as a percentage of its current value. Bigger steps cover the range faster; smaller ones aim more precisely.
hex.config.sensitivity.snap.tooltip: Applied the instant the key goes down, before you scroll, as a percentage of your normal sensitivity. Set it to 40%% and holding the key is instant precision aim. Leave it at 100%% to start where you already were.
hex.config.sensitivity.hud.tooltip: Draw a small panel under the crosshair while the key is held, showing where the wheel has taken your sensitivity as a percentage of your normal one — and, when the view has settled on one, the sticky angle it is sitting on.
hex.config.sensitivity.sticky.tooltip: While the key is held, draw the view onto round angles it comes near, so lining up on a wall or on the horizon lands exactly rather than nearly. Ordinary aiming is untouched: the pull exists only near an angle, fades to nothing at the edge of its reach, and a turn faster than it simply carries on through.
hex.config.sensitivity.sticky_yaw.toolti: Which left/right angles catch. Every 90° is the four block faces; every 45° adds the diagonals. Off leaves yaw to your custom angles alone.
hex.config.sensitivity.sticky_pitch.tool: Which up/down angles catch. Every 90° is level, straight up and straight down; the finer settings add the looks in between. Off leaves pitch to your custom angles alone.
hex.config.sensitivity.sticky_zone.toolt: How close to an angle the view has to come before it is pulled at all. Anything further away is left alone, so a long reach is stickier and a short one catches only what you were nearly on already.
hex.config.sensitivity.sticky_strength.t: How hard an angle pulls once you are inside its reach. Higher takes a faster turn to break away from — it can never stop one, because the pull fades to nothing at the edge of the reach.
hex.config.sensitivity.sticky_scale.tool: Grow the reach and the pull as the wheel takes you further below your normal sensitivity, so scrolling down to aim carefully also makes the angles easier to land on.
hex.config.sensitivity.sticky_angles.too: Add angles of your own on top of the regular ones above — for a wall, an NPC or a jump the world was not built square to.
hex.sticky.title: Sticky Angles
hex.sticky.empty: No custom angles. The regular intervals still apply.
hex.sticky.add.tooltip: Add an empty entry to type an angle into.
hex.sticky.capture_yaw.tooltip: Add the direction you are facing right now as a yaw angle.
hex.sticky.capture_pitch.tooltip: Add how far up or down you are looking right now as a pitch angle.
hex.sticky.toggle.tooltip: Switch this angle off without deleting it — the way to find out which of several is getting in the way.
hex.sticky.axis.tooltip: Whether this angle is a yaw (left/right) or a pitch (up/down).
hex.sticky.degrees.tooltip: The angle in Minecraft's own units, the ones F3 shows. Yaw is folded into -180 to 180 and pitch is clamped to -90 to 90 when you leave this screen.
hex.config.updates.enabled.tooltip: Check GitHub for a newer release each launch and stage it automatically.
hex.config.updates.include_prereleases.t: Treat GitHub pre-releases as updates too.
hex.config.updates.check_now.tooltip: Check GitHub for a newer release right now.
hex.config.keybinds.open_screen.tooltip: Open the keybind editor to add, edit and remove custom shortcuts.
hex.profiles.title: Hex Profiles
hex.profiles.duplicate.tooltip: Make a copy of this profile.
hex.profiles.edit.tooltip: Rename this profile, describe it, or set when it activates by itself.
hex.profiles.delete.tooltip: Delete this profile and its saved settings.
hex.profiles.delete.last.tooltip: The last remaining profile cannot be deleted.
hex.profiles.save.tooltip: Store your current settings into the active profile.
hex.profiles.discard.tooltip: Throw away your changes and reload the active profile as it was last saved.
hex.profiles.new.tooltip: Create a profile from the settings you have right now.
hex.profiles.export.tooltip: Copy every Hex setting to the clipboard as text you can send to someone else or keep as a backup.
hex.profiles.import.tooltip: Load a Hex export from the clipboard, either over this profile or as a new one.
hex.profiles.reset_all.tooltip: Restore every Hex setting to its default.
hex.profiles.capture_keys.tooltip: Also save Minecraft's own key bindings in each profile. Off by default: this covers every binding, including other mods', so switching a profile can undo a rebind you made elsewhere.
hex.profiles.new.title: New profile
hex.profiles.edit.title: Edit profile
hex.profiles.duplicate.title: Copy profile
hex.profiles.edit.name: Name
hex.profiles.edit.error.unusable: That name has no letters or digits in it.
hex.profiles.edit.error.taken: A profile with that name already exists.
hex.profiles.switch_prompt.title: Unsaved changes
hex.profiles.switch_prompt.message: Profile "%s" has changes you have not saved.
hex.profiles.switch_prompt.detail: Switching to "%s" will replace your current settings.
hex.profiles.discard.title: Discard changes?
hex.profiles.discard.message: Reload profile "%s" as it was last saved?
hex.profiles.discard.detail: Everything you have changed since then will be lost.
hex.profiles.delete.title: Delete profile?
hex.profiles.delete.detail: Its saved settings are removed for good.
hex.profiles.import.title: Paste settings
hex.profiles.import.message: How should the settings on your clipboard be used?
hex.profiles.import.detail: Importing here replaces your current settings; importing as new keeps them.
hex.profiles.reset_all.title: Reset everything?
hex.profiles.reset_all.message: Restore every Hex setting to its default?
hex.profiles.reset_all.detail: Your saved profiles are untouched — Discard brings the active one back.
hex.swing_items.title: Per-item swing
hex.swing_items.empty: No items yet. Hold a Skyblock item and press Add held item.
hex.swing_items.kind.tooltip: Item ID matches every copy of an item, such as HYPERION. UUID matches one specific item, and only unique items have one.
hex.swing_items.add_held.tooltip: Add the Skyblock item in your main hand.
hex.swing_items.add_held.unavailable: Hold a Skyblock item to add it. Vanilla items have no ID to match on.
hex.swing_items.add_empty.tooltip: Add a blank rule to type an ID into.
hex.config.titles.enabled.tooltip: Master switch for every title the mod shows. When off, reminders, regions and highlights still fire — they just say nothing in the middle of the screen.
hex.config.titles.sound_enabled.tooltip: Master switch for the sound a title plays. Individual titles can still be set to make none.
hex.config.titles.default_title_color.to: The colour used by any title that names none of its own. None leaves it the white the game uses.
hex.config.titles.default_subtitle_color: The same, for the smaller line underneath.
hex.config.titles.chroma_speed.tooltip: How long a title drawn in chroma takes to travel one full rainbow. Lower is faster. Shared by every chroma title.
hex.config.titles.chroma_width.tooltip: How many characters one full rainbow spans. Set it wide and a short word shifts colour as a whole rather than showing stripes.
hex.config.titles.default_fade_in.toolti: The fade a newly created title starts with. Titles you have already set up keep their own.
hex.config.titles.default_stay.tooltip: How long a newly created title holds before it fades. Titles you have already set up keep their own.
hex.config.titles.default_fade_out.toolt: The fade a newly created title ends with. Titles you have already set up keep their own.
hex.config.titles.preview.tooltip: Show a sample title with these defaults on it.
hex.titles.edit.title: Title style
hex.titles.edit.preview.tooltip: Show the title for real, behind this screen — fades and sound included.
hex.titles.edit.obfuscated: Obfuscated (&k) — scrambles the letters, the way an enchantment table reads.
hex.titles.edit.color.chroma: Chroma — a colour that flows, as an item name can
hex.titles.edit.color.custom: Any colour, as #RRGGBB — type one and press this.
hex.titles.preview.subtitle: and this is the line underneath
hex.config.title_edit.preset.tooltip: A ready-made look. Choosing one writes its codes at the front of both lines and sets the sound; your words and your timings are left alone.
hex.config.title_edit.fade_in.tooltip: How long the title takes to appear.
hex.config.title_edit.stay.tooltip: How long it holds at full brightness, once it has faded in.
hex.config.title_edit.fade_out.tooltip: How long it takes to disappear again.
hex.config.title_edit.sound.tooltip: Play a sound the moment the title appears. Separate from the alert's own sound, so an alert can have both, either, or neither.
hex.config.title_edit.sound_id.tooltip: A sound id, such as minecraft:block.note_block.pling. Press Preview to hear it.
hex.config.reminders.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. When off, nothing counts down and the panel is hidden, but your reminders are kept.
hex.config.reminders.hud_position.toolti: Drag the reminder panel to where you want it on screen.
hex.config.reminders.hud_corner.tooltip: Which corner of the panel stays put as reminders are added and removed.
hex.config.reminders.sort.tooltip: How the panel orders reminders. Anything firing is always shown first.
hex.config.reminders.hud_scale.tooltip: How large the panel is drawn.
hex.config.reminders.max_rows.tooltip: How many reminders the panel lists before collapsing the rest into a "+N more" line.
hex.config.reminders.background.tooltip: Draw a backing box behind the reminders so they stay readable over bright scenery.
hex.config.reminders.background_color.to: Panel background as #AARRGGBB. The first pair is opacity, so 80 is half transparent. Chroma works here too.
hex.config.reminders.text_color.tooltip: The colour the panel's rows are written in. Chroma works here too.
hex.config.reminders.flash_color.tooltip: The colour a reminder flashes in when it fires.
hex.config.reminders.chroma_speed.toolti: How long one full trip through the rainbow takes for a panel colour set to chroma. Lower is faster. Shared by the background, the text and the flash.
hex.config.reminders.skyblock_only.toolt: Hide the panel when the scoreboard does not look like Skyblock's.
hex.config.reminders.show_when_empty.too: Keep the panel on screen even when nothing is counting down.
hex.config.reminders.sound_enabled.toolt: Master switch for every reminder's sound. Individual reminders can still be set to make no sound.
hex.config.reminders.flash_seconds.toolt: How long a reminder stays highlighted on the panel after it fires.
hex.config.reminders.snooze_minutes.tool: How far the snooze keybind pushes a firing reminder back.
hex.reminders.hud.title: Reminder panel position
hex.reminders.hud.hint: Drag the panel, or nudge it with the arrow keys — hold Shift to move further.
hex.config.reminders.edit_list.tooltip: Add, edit and delete your reminders.
hex.config.reminders.presets.tooltip: Browse ready-made reminders and add the ones you want.
hex.reminders.title: Reminders
hex.reminders.empty: No reminders yet. Press Add, or take one from Presets.
hex.reminders.add.tooltip: Create a blank reminder and open it for editing.
hex.reminders.toggle.tooltip: Switch this reminder on or off. Switching a preset off does not count as editing it, so it still receives updates.
hex.reminders.delete.tooltip: Delete this reminder and its countdown.
hex.reminders.edit.title: Edit reminder
hex.reminders.edit.trigger_region.unknow: No region has that name yet.
hex.config.reminder_edit.name: Name
hex.config.reminder_edit.name.tooltip: What this reminder is called in the list.
hex.config.reminder_edit.text.tooltip: Shown on the panel when this fires. For a chat trigger, $1 to $9 insert the pattern's capture groups and $0 the whole match. Write $$ for a literal dollar sign.
The name of a region you have drawn, as it appears in the Regions tab.
hex.config.reminder_edit.trigger_pattern: The chat text to watch for. A regular expression unless Plain text is on — put (?i) at the start to ignore case, and use (…) to capture a part for the message.
The island name as it appears on the scoreboard, such as "dwarven mines".
hex.config.reminder_edit.trigger_item.to: The Skyblock item ID, such as HYPERION.
hex.config.reminder_edit.literal.tooltip: Match the pattern as ordinary text rather than a regular expression. Simpler, and it cannot capture anything.
hex.config.reminder_edit.delay.tooltip: How long after the trigger to fire. Write 0 to fire straight away, or something like 45s, 20m, 2h30m, 4d.
hex.config.reminder_edit.repeat.tooltip: Start the countdown again as soon as it fires.
hex.config.reminder_edit.conditions.tool: Limit when this is allowed to fire — for example, only on one island.
hex.config.reminder_edit.action_title.to: Show the message big, in the middle of the screen, the way the game announces things.
hex.config.reminder_edit.title_style.too: Colours, bold and italic, the subtitle, how long it holds and the sound it makes.
hex.config.reminder_edit.sound_id.toolti: A sound id, such as minecraft:block.note_block.pling. Press Test to hear it.
hex.config.reminder_edit.reset_preset.to: Discard your changes and take the version that ships with the mod.
hex.reminders.conditions.title: Conditions
hex.reminders.conditions.empty: No conditions — this reminder always fires.
hex.reminders.conditions.add.tooltip: Add a test that must pass for this reminder to fire.
hex.config.regions.edit_list.tooltip: Add, edit, preview and delete your regions.
hex.config.regions.default_radius.toolti: How far out a Region Here capture reaches sideways.
hex.config.regions.default_height.toolti: How far up and down a capture reaches from where you stand.
hex.config.regions.exit_margin.tooltip: How far outside a region you must go before it counts as left. Stops a region firing over and over while you stand on its edge.
hex.config.regions.preview_see_through.t: Draw previewed regions through terrain, so one behind a wall is still visible.
hex.config.regions.preview_names.tooltip: Float each region's name above it while previewing.
hex.config.regions.preview_color.tooltip: The colour used by a region that names none of its own. Chroma works here too.
hex.config.regions.draft_color.tooltip: The colour of a region while you are still drawing it.
hex.config.regions.chroma_speed.tooltip: How long one full trip through the rainbow takes for a region drawn in chroma. Lower is faster. Shared by every chroma region.
hex.config.regions.skyblock_only.tooltip: Ignore regions unless the scoreboard looks like Skyblock's.
hex.regions.title: Regions
hex.regions.empty: No regions yet. Press Add here, or walk one out.
hex.regions.empty_here: No regions on this island. Press Add here, or show all islands.
hex.regions.add_here.tooltip: Make a region around where you are standing, and open it for editing.
hex.regions.walk.tooltip: Record the outline you walk. Press Walk Region again, or run /hexa region walk, to finish.
hex.regions.preview.tooltip: Draw every region on this island in the world, so you can walk around and see them.
hex.regions.toggle.tooltip: Switch this region on or off.
hex.regions.delete.tooltip: Delete this region. Reminders that name it stop firing.
hex.regions.edit.title: Edit region
hex.config.region_edit.name: Name
hex.config.region_edit.name.tooltip: What this region is called. Reminders refer to it by this name, and renaming it updates them.
hex.config.region_edit.island.tooltip: The island this region is on, as it appears on the scoreboard. Leave blank to match anywhere — coordinates repeat across islands, so that is rarely what you want.
hex.config.region_edit.shape.tooltip: How the bounds below are read. A cylinder and a sphere take the largest size that fits inside the box.
hex.config.region_edit.text.tooltip: Shown when you enter the region.
hex.config.region_edit.notify_on_leave.t: Fire again when you walk back out.
hex.config.region_edit.leave_text.toolti: Shown when you leave. Leave blank to reuse the entry message.
hex.config.region_edit.title_style.toolt: Colours, bold and italic, the subtitle, how long it holds and the sound it makes.
hex.config.region_edit.sound_id.tooltip: A sound id, such as minecraft:block.note_block.pling. Press Test to hear it.
hex.config.region_edit.cooldown.tooltip: How long this region stays quiet after firing, so a doorway does not announce itself every time you step through.
hex.config.region_edit.color.tooltip: The colour this region is drawn in, or Chroma for one that flows through the rainbow.
hex.regions.capture.hint.mark: %s marks a corner — fly the freecam to reach one in the air
hex.regions.capture.hint.mark_cmd: /hexa region mark sets a corner — bind Mark Region Corner for one key
hex.regions.capture.hint.walk_cmd: /hexa region walk finishes, /hexa region cancel abandons
hex.config.highlights.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. When off nothing glows and no rule announces anything, but your rules are kept.
hex.config.highlights.edit_list.tooltip: Add, edit and delete the rules that decide which entities light up.
hex.config.highlights.scan_interval.tool: How often the world is checked for new matches. A higher number costs less and only delays how quickly a mob that has just spawned starts glowing.
hex.config.highlights.default_color.tool: The glow colour used by a rule that names none of its own. Chroma works here too.
hex.config.highlights.chroma_speed.toolt: How long one full trip through the rainbow takes for a rule glowing in chroma. Lower is faster. Shared by every chroma rule.
hex.config.highlights.name_tag_scale.too: How much bigger a marked name tag is drawn. A mob too far away for Hypixel to have sent shows only its name, and this is what makes that name easy to spot. 1.00× is the size the game draws it.
hex.config.highlights.skyblock_only.tool: Ignore every rule unless the scoreboard looks like Skyblock's.
hex.highlights.title: Entity highlights
hex.highlights.empty: No highlights yet. Look at something and press Add this.
hex.highlights.empty_here: No highlights for this island. Press All islands to see the rest.
hex.highlights.add_this.tooltip: Make a rule for the entity under your crosshair, and open it for editing. Your crosshair still points where it did before you opened this screen.
hex.highlights.add_empty.tooltip: Make a blank rule and open it, for when you already know what to type.
hex.highlights.toggle.tooltip: Switch this rule on or off.
hex.highlights.delete.tooltip: Delete this rule. Anything it was lighting up goes dark.
hex.highlights.edit.title: Edit highlight
hex.highlights.edit.value.blank: Fill this in, or the rule matches nothing.
hex.config.highlight_edit.name: Name
hex.config.highlight_edit.name.tooltip: What this rule is called. Shown in the list, in chat, and on the floating label.
hex.config.highlight_edit.kind.tooltip: Whether this rule looks at what an entity is called, or at what kind of entity it is.
hex.config.highlight_edit.value_name.too: Any part of the name, ignoring colours and capitals. On Hypixel a mob's name floats on a separate marker above it, and the mob underneath is what lights up. Run /hexa highlight nearby to read the names around you.
hex.config.highlight_edit.value_type.too: An entity id, such as minecraft:zombie. Every entity of that kind matches. Type part of a name and press Tab to complete it, or use the arrow keys to walk every entity the game knows.
hex.config.highlight_edit.island.tooltip: The island this rule works on, as it appears on the scoreboard. Leave blank to match anywhere.
hex.config.highlight_edit.color.tooltip: The outline colour, or Chroma for one that flows through the rainbow. An invisible entity has no outline to colour, so nothing shows for one.
hex.config.highlight_edit.max_distance.t: How far away a match still counts. Past it the entity neither glows nor announces itself.
hex.config.highlight_edit.show_label.too: Float this rule's name above everything it matches, unless the entity already shows a name of its own.
hex.config.highlight_edit.label_distance: Put how far away it is on the label as well.
hex.config.highlight_edit.notify.tooltip: Fire the actions below the first time each matching entity is seen. Leaving the world forgets what has been seen.
hex.config.highlight_edit.notify_text.to: Shown when a new one turns up. Leave blank to use the rule's name.
hex.config.highlight_edit.cooldown.toolt: How long this rule stays quiet after announcing, so a pack that spawns together is announced once rather than once each.
hex.config.highlight_edit.title_style.to: Colours, bold and italic, the subtitle, how long it holds and the sound it makes.
hex.config.highlight_edit.sound_id.toolt: A sound id, such as minecraft:block.note_block.pling. Press Test to hear it.
hex.config.chat_highlights.enabled.toolt: Master switch. When off nothing in chat is repainted, hidden or announced, but your rules are kept.
hex.config.chat_highlights.edit_list.too: Add, edit and delete the rules that decide which chat text stands out.
hex.config.chat_highlights.default_color: The colour used by a rule that names none of its own. Chroma works here too.
How long one full trip through the rainbow takes. Lower is faster. Shared by every chroma rule.
How many characters one rainbow spans. Set it wide and a short word shifts colour as a whole instead of striping.
hex.config.chat_highlights.skyblock_only: Ignore every rule unless the scoreboard looks like Skyblock's.
hex.chat_highlights.title: Chat highlights
hex.chat_highlights.empty: No chat highlights yet. Press Add to make one.
hex.chat_highlights.empty_here: No highlights for this island. Press All islands to see the rest.
hex.chat_highlights.add.tooltip: Make a blank rule and open it for editing.
hex.chat_highlights.toggle.tooltip: Switch this rule on or off.
hex.chat_highlights.delete.tooltip: Delete this rule. Chat stops being marked for it from the next message.
hex.chat_highlights.edit.title: Edit chat highlight
hex.chat_highlights.edit.preview_empty: Fill in the text to look for, and it will be shown here as chat will show it.
hex.chat_highlights.edit.text.blank: Fill this in, or the rule matches nothing.
hex.config.chat_highlight_edit.name: Name
hex.config.chat_highlight_edit.name.tool: What this rule is called. Shown in the list, and used by a notification that names no message of its own.
hex.config.chat_highlight_edit.text.tool: The words to look for. Plain text, not a pattern — a message counts when it contains this anywhere.
hex.config.chat_highlight_edit.case_sens: On, the capitals have to match too. Useful for an all-caps broadcast, unhelpful for a name someone might type either way.
hex.config.chat_highlight_edit.channel.t: Which chat this rule listens to. Any also covers the server's own broadcasts, which belong to no channel.
hex.config.chat_highlight_edit.islands.t: The islands this rule works on, as they appear on the scoreboard, separated by commas. Leave blank to match anywhere.
hex.config.chat_highlight_edit.scope.too: Whether the colour covers only the words that matched, or the whole message.
hex.config.chat_highlight_edit.color.too: The colour the matched text is painted in. Choose Chroma to flow it through the rainbow.
hex.config.chat_highlight_edit.obfuscate: Draw the text as characters that never settle. Hides what it marks, so it suits censoring rather than highlighting.
hex.config.chat_highlight_edit.prefix.to: Text put in front of the match, such as ». Visible in a screenshot and to a colour-blind player, which a colour is not.
hex.config.chat_highlight_edit.suffix.to: Text put after the match, such as «.
hex.config.chat_highlight_edit.hide.tool: Drop the whole message from chat. It still counts as a match, so a rule can silence spam and keep its sound.
hex.config.chat_highlight_edit.notify.to: Fire the actions below when a message matches. Leave off for a rule that only paints.
hex.config.chat_highlight_edit.notify_te: Shown when a match arrives. Leave blank to use the rule's name.
How long this rule stays quiet after announcing, so a busy channel cannot keep a title on screen.
hex.config.chat_highlight_edit.title_sty: Colours, bold and italic, the subtitle, how long it holds and the sound it makes.
A sound id, such as minecraft:block.note_block.pling. Press Test to hear it.
hex.reminders.presets.title: Reminder presets
hex.reminders.preset.forge_on_arrival.de: Reminds you to look at your forge slots whenever you arrive in the Dwarven Mines.
hex.reminders.preset.hourly_check.name: Hourly check-in
hex.reminders.preset.hourly_check.desc: Every hour on Skyblock, a nudge to check pets, forge and bazaar orders.
hex.config.suggest.enabled.tooltip: Suggest commands in the chat box, learned from the ones you actually use.
hex.config.suggest.learning.tooltip: Off keeps suggesting from what it already knows, but records nothing new.
hex.config.suggest.dashboard.tooltip: Inspect, pin, block or forget individual commands, and see why each one is suggested.
hex.config.suggest.popup.tooltip: Show the ranked list above the chat box. Arrow keys move, Tab accepts, Escape dismisses.
hex.config.suggest.ghost_text.tooltip: Grey out the rest of the line as you type, when the guess is confident enough.
hex.config.suggest.next_command.tooltip: Typing just a slash offers what you would most likely want here — from your location, what you are holding, and what you just ran.
hex.config.suggest.rows.tooltip: How many suggestions the list shows at once.
hex.config.suggest.confidence.tooltip: How sure it must be before completing the line inline. Higher means it stays quiet more often.
hex.config.suggest.adaptation.tooltip: How fast old habits are forgotten. Faster suits play that changes week to week.
hex.config.suggest.accept_key.tooltip: Which key takes the highlighted suggestion or the inline completion.
hex.config.suggest.catalogue_priors.tool: Offer common Skyblock commands before you have used them. Off means nothing is suggested until you type it yourself.
hex.config.suggest.learn_player_names.to: Remember who you message and visit, so their names complete. Message text is never recorded either way.
hex.suggest.forget_all.tooltip: Wipe every command Hex has learned. Your settings are kept.
hex.config.suggest.forget_all.tooltip: Wipe every command Hex has learned. Your settings are kept.
hex.suggest.title: What Hex has learned
hex.suggest.empty: Nothing learned yet — run some commands and come back.
hex.suggest.learning.tooltip: Pause to keep the suggestions you have but stop recording new commands.
hex.suggest.why.tooltip: Show exactly why this is suggested, here and now.
hex.suggest.pin.tooltip: Pin to the top of every list it appears in.
hex.suggest.block.tooltip: Never suggest this, and stop recording it.
hex.suggest.forget_all.confirm: Forget every command Hex has learned?
hex.suggest.forget_all.detail: Your settings are kept. This cannot be undone.
hex.suggest.why.title: Why this suggestion
hex.config.item_custom.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. When off, every item looks the way Hypixel sends it, but your customizations are kept.
hex.config.item_custom.manage.tooltip: See everything you have customized, edit an entry, or remove one.
hex.config.item_custom.mark_slots.toolti: Draw a small ✎ on inventory slots holding an item you have customized.
hex.config.item_custom.chroma_speed.tool: How long one full trip through the rainbow takes. Lower is faster. Shared by every chroma name.
hex.config.item_custom.chroma_width.tool: How many characters one full rainbow spans. Low values pack every colour into a short name; high values make it drift through one colour at a time.
hex.item_custom.title: Customized items
hex.item_custom.empty: Nothing customized yet. Hover an item in any menu and press Customize Hovered Item.
hex.item_custom.edit.tooltip: Change this item's name, colour, glint or appearance.
hex.item_custom.delete.tooltip: Remove this customization. The item goes back to how Hypixel sends it.
hex.item_custom.add_held.tooltip: Customize the item in your main hand.
hex.item_custom.add_held.unavailable: Hold a unique Skyblock item. Stackable and vanilla items have no UUID to key a customization on.
hex.item_custom.edit.title: Customize item
hex.item_custom.delete.title: Delete customization?
hex.item_custom.delete.message: Show this item the way Hypixel sends it again?
hex.item_custom.deny.no_item: Point at an item to customize it.
hex.item_custom.deny.no_uuid: That item has no UUID, so it cannot be customized. Only unique, non-stackable Skyblock items have one.
hex.item_custom.command.list: /hexa item list — manage your customized items
hex.config.item_custom_edit.enabled.tool: Switch this customization off without deleting it.
hex.config.item_custom_edit.name: Name
hex.config.item_custom_edit.name.tooltip: What to call this item. Use & followed by a colour or format code, such as &6 for gold or &l for bold — and &z for chroma from that point on. Leave blank to keep Hypixel's name.
hex.config.item_custom_edit.color.toolti: Colours the whole name, or flows it through the rainbow with Chroma. With the Name field blank this recolours Hypixel's own name, which drops the colours it came with.
hex.config.item_custom_edit.glint.toolti: Whether the item shimmers. Cosmetic only — its enchantments are untouched.
hex.config.item_custom_edit.model.toolti: The model to draw instead, such as minecraft:diamond_sword. Any model your resource packs provide works too. Leave blank to keep the item's own.
hex.config.item_custom_edit.model.invali: No model with that id is loaded.
hex.config.item_custom_edit.texture.tool: A player-head skin to draw. Paste a texture hash, a textures.minecraft.net link, or the base64 value from an item. Setting one draws the item as a head unless Item model says otherwise.
hex.config.item_custom_edit.texture.inva: Not a texture hash, link or value.
hex.config.item_custom_edit.dye.tooltip: Recolours a dyeable model, such as leather armour. Nothing happens on a model that cannot be dyed.
hex.config.notebook.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. When off, the keybind and the commands do nothing. Your notes are kept exactly as they are.
hex.config.notebook.open.tooltip: Browse, write and organise your notes.
hex.config.notebook.sort.tooltip: What order the note list is in. Pinned notes stay at the top whichever you pick.
hex.config.notebook.sort.title: Title
hex.config.notebook.editor_view.tooltip: Whether the note editor shows the markdown you type, the preview of how it reads, or both side by side. The button in the editor's toolbar changes it too.
hex.config.notebook.show_snippets.toolti: Draw the first line of each note under its title, so a list of similarly-named notes is still navigable.
hex.config.notebook.background_opacity.t: How solid the notebook and the note editor are. Lower it to see the game through them, raise it for a flat backdrop behind the text.
hex.config.notebook.line_spacing.tooltip: Extra space between the lines of a note, in the preview and the reading screen. Raise it for prose you read while playing, lower it to fit a long checklist on one screen. The editing pane uses Minecraft's own line height and is not affected.
hex.notebook.title: Notebook
hex.notebook.empty: No notes yet. Press New to write one.
hex.notebook.new.tooltip: Start a note and open it. If a folder is selected, it is filed there.
hex.notebook.import.tooltip: Take whatever is on the clipboard as a new note. Plain markdown works; a note exported from Hex also brings its folder, tags, colour and icon.
hex.notebook.import.too_new: That note was written by a newer Hex (format %s).
hex.notebook.view.tooltip: Read this note full width, with nothing to edit. Check boxes still tick.
hex.notebook.pin.tooltip: Keep this note at the top of the list.
hex.notebook.duplicate.tooltip: Make a copy of this note.
hex.notebook.delete.tooltip: Delete this note. There is no undo.
hex.notebook.delete.title: Delete note?
hex.notebook.delete.message: Its text is gone for good.
hex.notebook.export.tooltip: Copy this note to the clipboard, ready to paste anywhere. It carries its folder, tags, colour and icon with it.
hex.notebook.meta.tooltip: Where this note is filed, and how its row looks.
hex.notebook.meta.title: Note details
hex.notebook.editor.title: Edit note
hex.notebook.editor.read_only: Written by a newer Hex — changes will not be saved.
hex.notebook.view.title: Reading a note
hex.notebook.view.edit.tooltip: Open this note in the editor.
hex.notebook.view.task.tooltip: Click a check box to tick it off.
hex.notebook.editor.view.tooltip: Switch between the markdown source, the preview, and both side by side.
hex.notebook.editor.task: Checklist item — press again to tick it off, and again to make it an ordinary line.
hex.notebook.editor.link.label: text
hex.notebook.editor.color.chroma: Chroma — a colour that flows, as an item name can
hex.notebook.editor.color.custom: Any colour, as #RRGGBB — type one and press this.
hex.config.notebook_meta.folder.tooltip: Where this note is filed, as a path such as mining/dwarven. Folders appear in the sidebar for as long as something is in them. Leave blank for none.
hex.config.notebook_meta.tags.tooltip: Comma-separated labels, such as mining, prices. A note can carry as many as you like, and each one becomes a sidebar filter.
hex.config.notebook_meta.color.tooltip: The colour of the bar down the left of this note's row. Leave blank for the default.
hex.config.notebook_meta.icon.tooltip: An item id to draw beside the title, such as minecraft:diamond_pickaxe. Leave blank for a book.
hex.config.notebook_meta.icon.invalid: No item with that id is loaded.
hex.config.notebook_meta.pinned.tooltip: Keep this note at the top of the list, whatever the sort order is.
